contract: GET /api/users/online. Admin online-user listing returns usersOnline and openSessions snapshots with the client-consumed user/session fields; non-admin access denies.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.

invariants.contract: GET /api/users/online returns {usersOnline, openSessions}: one entry per user with an authenticated socket (id, username, type, session, lastSeen, createdAt, connections = number of sockets), unauthenticated sockets excluded; a user with an open playback session carries it and it is listed in openSessions; a user leaves usersOnline when its last socket disconnects.
GET /api/users/online answers 401 without a valid token, 403 to a non-admin and 200 to any admin (the route has no id middleware).
